conventions.S: sum over ok curves (sorted by c) of gap_C (integer)
conventions.M: sum over ok curves of the mean of the 20 null_C (exact rational)
conventions.V: sum over ok curves of the SAMPLE variance (divisor 19) of the 20 null_C, as the statement says; V_population (divisor 20) reported for sensitivity
conventions.z: (S - M) / sqrt(V (1 + 1/20)), Decimal at 60 digits; threshold comparisons decided exactly as (S-M)^2 vs 16 V 21/20
conventions.plant: plant_kappa = sum plant_C / M, plant_z = (sum plant_C - M) / sqrt(V 21/20) with the same M and V
conventions.z_cal: pooled over the cell's ok curves exactly like z: (sum null_C[0] - sum mean(null_C[1..19])) / sqrt(sum samplevar(null_C[1..19]) (1 + 1/19)); Stouffer and population-variance alternatives reported
conventions.bootstrap: seed(cell, family) = int.from_bytes(sha256(('TASK-20261029-2c7b52|J1|bootstrap|' + family + '|' + cell).encode()).digest()[:8], 'big'); random.Random(seed); records sorted by curve index; each resample draws k = (number of ok curves) indices by rng.randrange(k) in sequence; 2000 resamples; kappa* = sum gap_C / sum mean null_C over the drawn curves (with multiplicity). Family A is the primary; family B is a Monte Carlo sensitivity draw only. Percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 under nearest-rank (rank ceil(qB/100), i.e. 50th and 1950th of 2000) and linear interpolation (h = (B-1) q/100, type 7).
conventions.plant_feasible: recorded per-job flag; rederived as plant_internal >= 0.30 x mean(null_C) for comparison
conventions.invalid_cells: statistics of an invalid cell are computed over its ok records and are descriptive only
conventions.null_mean_over_formula: M / sum over ok curves of 3 binom(n,4)/p_curve; anomaly outside [0.8, 1.25] (R6), descriptive
